video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone selfie video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman, a woman in her mid-twenties with shoulder-length wavy honey-blonde hair, light freckles and green eyes, wearing a soft sage-green knit cardigan over a white top, sits alone in a bright cozy living room with a light grey sofa, a tall green plant, a wooden bookshelf and a window with sheer white curtains in daylight, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. The phone rests on a tripod and the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little emotional, like telling a friend a personal story, with small natural head movements and expressive hand gestures in front of her chest.
